about.title: About Insurance Over Texas Agency
text: Insurance Over Texas is a family owned and operated independent Houston insurance agency with personal and commercial insurance policies.

Insurance Over Texas Agency, LLC formally Dale Jackson Insurance Agency has been in business for over 30 years. Former owner Dale Jackson recently retired, and the agency was purchased by longtime employee Martha Juarez. Under new ownership, Insurance Over Texas continues to offer quality, low-cost policies that will be structured for your individual needs.

Owner and agent Martha Juarez has more than 15 years of experience in Texas insurance. She is married with two children and is thrilled to be a new business owner. Martha loves working out with other moms at the gym to shake off stress. Some of her favorite things to do are spending time with her family at the lake camping, hiking, and just relaxing. Martha volunteers her time at her local church, and in her spare time, crochets beanies and blankets for local charities. We’d love to learn more about your family and how we can help you find the best insurance in Texas.
